name: Lífþrasir Main
source:
Fifty years into the future, the leader of the Lífþrasir space colony encounters a visitor from Earth with a mysterious agenda.

[From [url=http://renai.us/game/lifthrasirmain.shtml]Ren'Ai Archive[/url]]

五十年後的未來，Lífþrasir太空殖民地的領袖遇見了一名來自地球的訪客，對方的來意成謎。
